newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse Electric faces investor suit.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse Electric faces investor suit.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp investors filed a class-action suit charging the company misrepresented the financial health of its Westinghouse Financial Services Inc subsidiary, inflating securities prices, plaintiffs' lawyers said Thursday.
Attorneys at the firm Curtis V. Trinko LLP said in a statement they would seek damages in the case but did not disclose a dollar amount.
The complaint, filed May 27 in a federal court in Pennsylvania, was brought on behalf of investors who bought Westinghouse securities from March 29, 1990, through October 22, 1991.

The complaint alleges the company, some of its officers, certain of its subsidiaries and the underwriters for a 1991 public offering misstated information about the financial health of the unit, which "artificially inflated the market price of Westinghouse securities."
No one was immediately available at Westinghouse to comment on the case.
